WITH per_film_daily_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate / rental_duration AS daily_rate
  FROM film
),
per_rating_average AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(daily_rate) AS avg_daily_rate
  FROM per_film_daily_rate
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_rating_average
),
filtered_ratings AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_daily_rate
  FROM per_rating_average
  WHERE avg_daily_rate > (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_daily_rate) AS avg_per_day,
  AVG(avg_daily_rate - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_average)) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_ratings
